title: everyday parts: a flange, a ribbed bracket, a keyed shaft, a slotted plate, a pocket, a cup

cases.name: c001
cases.description: a flange: a disc (radius 30, 8 thick) with a boss (radius 12) to 23, a bore (radius 6) through, a bolt hole (radius 3) at (22, 0) patterned 6 times round; the boss's top edge filleted 2 mm and its foot 1 mm

cases.name: c002
cases.description: batch 006's L (a 40 × 30 × 4 plate, a wall 4 thick and 24 tall at x = 0) with a rib 3 thick across its middle, two holes (radius 2.5) through the plate, the plate's far top edge chamfered 1 mm and the wall's outer top edge filleted 2 mm

cases.name: c003
cases.description: a shaft (radius 10, 60 long, along x) with a keyway 20 long, 6 wide and 4 deep cut in its top, both ends chamfered 1 mm

cases.name: c004
cases.description: a 60 × 30 × 6 plate with an obround slot (40 long, 10 wide) through its middle, the slot's top edge chamfered 0.5 mm all round

cases.name: c005
cases.description: a 60 × 40 × 10 plate with a 40 × 20 pocket 6 deep: the pocket's corners filleted 4 mm, then its floor's edge 1 mm all round

cases.name: c006
cases.description: a cup: a cylinder (radius 20, 30 tall), its foot filleted 3 mm, shelled 2 mm open at its top
